per output coordinate. It uses PTX 8.0, target `sm_80`, and 64-bit addressing.
The four kernel arguments are generic pointers to global buffers, in the order

Prove successful execution and preservation of all 32-bit registers, untouched 64-bit registers, and global memory under explicit parameter and address-window assumptions.

  | .input => "x_ptr"
  | .bias => "b_ptr"
  | .output => "y_ptr"

  | .input => .inputRead
  | .bias => .biasBase
  | .output => .outputBase

    .ldParam64 .inputRead "x_ptr",
    .ldParam64 .biasBase "b_ptr",
    .ldParam64 .outputBase "y_ptr",

Parameter storage is a read-only map from declared symbol names to optional
64-bit words. `ld.param.u64` reads the named slot and writes its word into a
64-bit register. This models direct loads from declared, naturally aligned
64-bit parameter slots. Host argument serialization and byte-level parameter
layout are outside this representation. The rule follows NVIDIA's
[load instruction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.0.1/parallel-thread-execution/index.html#data-movement-and-conversion-instructions-ld)
description.

structure Environment where
  params : String → Option Word64
  space : AddressSpace

def Environment.empty : Environment :=
  ⟨fun _ => none, ⟨⟨0, 0, by decide⟩, []⟩⟩

The address-space configuration supplies a bounded global window and a list
of excluded windows for other state spaces. A generic pointer is admitted
when it lies within the global window and outside the excluded windows.
`cvta.to.global.u64` converts it by subtracting the global-window base.
The conversion reads the incoming register value, including when source and
destination are the same register. The window bounds prevent subtraction or
representation wraparound for admitted pointers. This is the selected window
model described by NVIDIA's [generic addressing](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.0.1/parallel-thread-execution/index.html#generic-addressing)
and [address conversion](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.0.1/parallel-thread-execution/index.html#data-movement-and-conversion-instructions-cvta)
sections. The window configuration is an explicit environment assumption;
its correspondence to a CUDA device is not proved.

/-- A nonwrapping window in the generic 64-bit address space. -/
structure Window where
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  end_le : base + size ≤ 2 ^ 64

def Window.contains (w : Window) (a : Word64) : Bool :=
  decide (w.base ≤ a.toNat ∧ a.toNat < w.base + w.size)

/-- Excluded windows represent non-global spaces; kernel-param windows need not be excluded. -/
structure AddressSpace where
  globalWindow : Window
  excluded : List Window

def AddressSpace.admits (space : AddressSpace) (a : Word64) : Bool :=
  space.globalWindow.contains a && !(space.excluded.any (fun w => w.contains a))

def AddressSpace.globalAddress (space : AddressSpace) (a : Word64) : Word64 :=
  BitVec.ofNat 64 (a.toNat - space.globalWindow.base)

/-- Partial semantics deliberately excludes conversions outside the admitted region. -/
def AddressSpace.toGlobal (space : AddressSpace) (a : Word64) : Option Word64 :=
  if space.admits a then some (space.globalAddress a) else none

theorem AddressSpace.toGlobal_of_admits (space : AddressSpace) (a : Word64)
    (h : space.admits a = true) : space.toGlobal a = some (space.globalAddress a) := by
  simp [AddressSpace.toGlobal, h]

theorem AddressSpace.globalAddress_toNat (space : AddressSpace) (a : Word64) :
    (space.globalAddress a).toNat = a.toNat - space.globalWindow.base := by
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) a.isLt)

theorem AddressSpace.admitted_bounds (space : AddressSpace) (a : Word64)
    (h : space.admits a = true) :
    space.globalWindow.base ≤ a.toNat ∧
      (space.globalAddress a).toNat < space.globalWindow.size := by
  have hw : space.globalWindow.contains a = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).1
  have hb : space.globalWindow.base ≤ a.toNat ∧
      a.toNat < space.globalWindow.base + space.globalWindow.size := by
    simpa [Window.contains] using hw
  rw [AddressSpace.globalAddress_toNat]
  omega

The execution rules return no modeled successor for a missing parameter slot
or a pointer outside the admitted global region. This restricts the model to
valid uses of these instructions. NVIDIA leaves invalid address conversions
undefined; the absence of a modeled successor does not specify a GPU trap.

/-- All operands are read before the destination is updated. BitVec arithmetic wraps. -/
def Instruction.execute [DecidableEq Reg] (id : Identity) (s : State Reg)
    (inst : Instruction Reg) (env : Environment := Environment.empty)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) : Option (State Reg) :=
  match inst with
  | .mov dst src => some (s.write dst (src.read id s))
  | .madLo dst a b c => some (s.write dst (a.read id s * b.read id s + c.read id s))
  | .mulWide dst a b => some (s.write64 dst (wideProduct (a.read id s) (b.read id s)))
  | .add64 dst a b => some (s.write64 dst (a.read s + b.read s))
  | .ldParam64 dst symbol => (env.params symbol).map (s.write64 dst)
  | .cvtaGlobal64 dst src => (env.space.toGlobal (src.read s)).map (s.write64 dst)
  | .movF32 dst value => some (s.write dst value)
  | .loadF32 dst address => (s.globalMemory (address.read s)).map (s.write dst)
  | .fmaRN dst a b c => ops.map (fun op =>
      s.write dst (op.fmaRN (a.read id s) (b.read id s) (c.read id s)))
  | .add32 dst a b => some (s.write dst (a.read id s + b.read id s))
  | .setpLt dst a b => some { s with
      predicates := fun r => if r = dst then decide ((a.read id s).toNat < (b.read id s).toNat)
        else s.predicates r
      pc := s.pc + 1 }
  | .branchIf predicate target => some { s with
      pc := if s.predicates predicate then target else s.pc + 1 }
  | .addF32RN dst a b => ops.map (fun op =>
      s.write dst (op.addRN (a.read id s) (b.read id s)))
  | .maxPositiveZero dst src => some (s.write dst (FP32.maxPositiveZero (src.read id s)))
  | .storeF32 address src => some { s with
      globalMemory := fun a => if a = address.read s then some (src.read id s) else s.globalMemory a
      pc := s.pc + 1 }
  | .ret => some { s with returned := true, pc := s.pc + 1 }

/-- Active threads fetch at the current PC; returned threads have no next step. -/
def step [DecidableEq Reg] (program : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity)
    (s : State Reg) (env : Environment := Environment.empty)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) : Option (State Reg) :=
  if s.returned then none else
    (program[s.pc]?).bind (fun inst => inst.execute id s env ops)

/-- Execute exactly `fuel` instructions; failed fetches and excluded instruction uses yield `none`. -/
def run [DecidableEq Reg] (program : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : State Reg) (env : Environment := Environment.empty)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) : Option (State Reg) :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => some s
  | fuel + 1 => (step program id s env ops).bind (fun next => run program id fuel next env ops)

theorem run_add [DecidableEq Reg] (program : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity)
    (a b : Nat) (s : State Reg) (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic) :
    run program id (a + b) s env ops =
      (run program id a s env ops).bind (fun next => run program id b next env ops) := by
  induction a generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [run]
  | succ a ih => simp [Nat.succ_add, run, ih, Option.bind_assoc]

private theorem step_append_of_step [DecidableEq Reg]
    (program suffix : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity) (s next : State Reg)
    (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic)
    (h : step program id s env ops = some next) :
    step (program ++ suffix) id s env ops = some next := by
  have hpc : s.pc < program.length := by
    by_contra hn
    have hf := List.getElem?_eq_none (l := program) (by omega : program.length ≤ s.pc)
    simp [step, hf] at h
  simpa only [step, List.getElem?_append_left hpc] using h

/-- Appending instructions cannot change an already successful prefix execution. -/
theorem run_append_of_run [DecidableEq Reg]
    (program suffix : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity) (fuel : Nat)
    (s final : State Reg) (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic)
    (h : run program id fuel s env ops = some final) :
    run (program ++ suffix) id fuel s env ops = some final := by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero => simpa [run] using h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    obtain ⟨next, hs, ht⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    have he := step_append_of_step program suffix id s next env ops hs
    simpa only [run, he, Option.bind_some] using ih next ht

Starting with an active thread at fragment-relative PC zero, all eight

private def finalState (env : Environment) (args : Argument → Word64)
    (initial : State Register) : State Register :=
  let s := initial.write64 .weightBase (args .weights)
  let s := s.write64 .inputRead (args .input)
  let s := s.write64 .biasBase (args .bias)
  let s := s.write64 .outputBase (args .output)
  let s := s.write64 .weightBase (env.space.globalAddress (s.regs64 .weightBase))
  let s := s.write64 .inputRead (env.space.globalAddress (s.regs64 .inputRead))
  let s := s.write64 .biasBase (env.space.globalAddress (s.regs64 .biasBase))
  s.write64 .outputBase (env.space.globalAddress (s.regs64 .outputBase))

/-- The block's exit contract, including register and memory frame conditions. -/
structure BaseResult (env : Environment) (args : Argument → Word64)
    (initial final : State Register) : Prop where
  pc : final.pc = 8
  bases : ∀ arg : Argument, final.regs64 arg.register = env.space.globalAddress (args arg)
  bounds : ∀ arg : Argument, (final.regs64 arg.register).toNat < env.space.globalWindow.size
  regs32 : final.regs = initial.regs
  other64 : ∀ r, r ≠ .weightBase → r ≠ .inputRead → r ≠ .biasBase → r ≠ .outputBase →
    final.regs64 r = initial.regs64 r
  memory : final.globalMemory = initial.globalMemory
  predicates : final.predicates = initial.predicates
  active : final.returned = initial.returned

/-- Four initialized parameter slots and four admitted pointers suffice for all eight steps. -/
theorem baseLoading_correct (env : Environment) (args : Argument → Word64) (id : Identity)
    (initial : State Register) (hpc : initial.pc = 0) (hactive : initial.returned = false)
    (hparams : ∀ arg : Argument, env.params arg.symbol = some (args arg))
    (hspace : ∀ arg : Argument, env.space.admits (args arg) = true)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) :
    ∃ final, run baseLoading id 8 initial env ops = some final ∧
      BaseResult env args initial final := by
  have hpw := hparams .weights
  have hpx := hparams .input
  have hpb := hparams .bias
  have hpy := hparams .output
  simp only [Argument.symbol] at hpw hpx hpb hpy
  have hw := env.space.toGlobal_of_admits (args .weights) (hspace .weights)
  have hx := env.space.toGlobal_of_admits (args .input) (hspace .input)
  have hb := env.space.toGlobal_of_admits (args .bias) (hspace .bias)
  have hy := env.space.toGlobal_of_admits (args .output) (hspace .output)
  refine ⟨finalState env args initial, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [run, step, baseLoading, Instruction.execute, Operand64.read,
      State.write64, finalState, hpc, hactive, hpw, hpx, hpb, hpy, hw, hx, hb, hy]
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [finalState, State.write64, hpc]
    · intro arg
      cases arg <;> simp [finalState, State.write64, Argument.register]
    · intro arg
      have heq : (finalState env args initial).regs64 arg.register =
          env.space.globalAddress (args arg) := by
        cases arg <;> simp [finalState, State.write64, Argument.register]
      rw [heq]
      exact (env.space.admitted_bounds (args arg) (hspace arg)).2
    · rfl
    · intro r hw hx hb hy
      simp [finalState, State.write64, hw, hx, hb, hy]
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl

/-- Register names shared by all selected kernel blocks. -/
inductive Register where
  | thread | block | row
  | weightBase | inputRead | biasBase | outputBase
  | rowOffset | elementOffset | weightRead | biasRead | outputWrite
  | column | weightValue | inputValue | accumulator | more
  | biasValue | result
  deriving DecidableEq

def Register.ptxName : Register → String
  | .thread => "%thread"
  | .block => "%block"
  | .row => "%row"
  | .weightBase => "%W_base"
  | .inputRead => "%x_read"
  | .biasBase => "%b_base"
  | .outputBase => "%y_base"
  | .rowOffset => "%row_offset"
  | .elementOffset => "%element_offset"
  | .weightRead => "%W_read"
  | .biasRead => "%b_read"
  | .outputWrite => "%y_write"
  | .column => "%j"
  | .weightValue => "%w"
  | .inputValue => "%x"
  | .accumulator => "%acc"
  | .more => "%more"
  | .biasValue => "%bias"
  | .result => "%result"

private def operandText : Operand Register → String
  | .reg r => r.ptxName
  | .imm v => toString v.toNat
  | .tidX => "%tid.x"
  | .ctaidX => "%ctaid.x"

private def operand64Text : Operand64 Register → String
  | .reg r => r.ptxName
  | .imm v => toString v.toNat

/-- Render the selected instruction forms for executable source-fragment comparisons. -/
def Instruction.ptxText : Instruction Register → String
  | .mov dst src => s!"mov.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText src};"
  | .madLo dst a b c =>
      s!"mad.lo.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b}, {operandText c};"
  | .mulWide dst a b => s!"mul.wide.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .add64 dst a b => s!"add.u64 {dst.ptxName}, {operand64Text a}, {operand64Text b};"
  | .ldParam64 dst symbol => s!"ld.param.u64 {dst.ptxName}, [{symbol}];"
  | .cvtaGlobal64 dst src => s!"cvta.to.global.u64 {dst.ptxName}, {operand64Text src};"
  | .movF32 dst value =>
      let digits := Nat.toDigits 16 value.toNat
      s!"mov.f32 {dst.ptxName}, 0f{String.ofList (List.replicate (8 - digits.length) '0' ++ digits)};"
  | .loadF32 dst address => s!"ld.global.f32 {dst.ptxName}, [{operand64Text address}];"
  | .fmaRN dst a b c => s!"fma.rn.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b}, {operandText c};"
  | .add32 dst a b => s!"add.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .setpLt dst a b => s!"setp.lt.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .branchIf predicate target => s!"@{predicate.ptxName} bra PC_{target};"
  | .addF32RN dst a b => s!"add.rn.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .maxPositiveZero dst src => s!"max.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText src}, 0f00000000;"
  | .storeF32 address src => s!"st.global.f32 [{operand64Text address}], {operandText src};"
  | .ret => "ret;"

private def instructionText : Instruction Register → String := Instruction.ptxText

def main (arguments : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let source ← IO.FS.readFile (arguments.headD "kernels/relu_layer.ptx")
  let normalized := "\n" ++ String.intercalate "\n"
    ((source.splitOn "\n").map (fun line => line.trimAscii.toString))
  let expected := "\n" ++ String.intercalate "\n" (baseLoading.map instructionText) ++ "\n"
  unless (normalized.splitOn expected).length == 2 do
    throw (IO.userError s!"Expected exactly one base-loading fragment:\n{expected}")
  let declarations := ".visible .entry relu_layer(\n" ++
    String.intercalate ",\n" ([Argument.weights, .input, .bias, .output].map
      (fun arg => s!".param .u64 {arg.symbol}")) ++ "\n)\n"
  unless (normalized.splitOn declarations).length == 2 do
    throw (IO.userError "The kernel's four u64 parameter declarations do not match.")
  IO.println "Eight base-loading instructions and four parameter declarations match the formal block."
